@name: Warrior Monk
@slug: warrior_monk
@realms: Mentalism
@prime_stats: Qu, SD
@description:
 Warrior Monks are non spell users who are experts at maneuvering and martial
 arts. Warrior Monks may learn to use normal weapons, although not as easily
 as others in the realm of Arms. They prefer to utilize unarmed combat. Some
 literary examples of a Warrior Monk might include Kwi Chang Kane.
